subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) SL-XQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5296b4a154c1ac8cbdbdce2da80d22d07f374ddb4d50d748b7fc98f6c28c92fc.png] 

Option 2) **CW-HA **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf265e7c67e25e8f366bd9fd91038aed911e6aaf0cd9928be97f6572ff58342f.png] 

Option 3) GZ-LE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33a37214804f38fcb6b363dac8711a1d9982a31ed9783b7812e8425e2e6f7943.png] 

Option 4) WP-BU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11f5577735165f7f4f8bff3c91a7ec89eb64576187d249271c760f248837dae2.png] 

Here, 'CW-HA' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
